# sdwan_policy_object_security_rule_set (Resource)

This resource can manage a Policy Object Security Rule Set Policy_object.
  - Minimum SD-WAN Manager version: `20.18.0`

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sdwan_policy_object_security_rule_set" "example" {
  name               = "Example"
  description        = "My Example"
  feature_profile_id = "f6dd22c8-0b4f-496c-9a0b-6813d1f8b8ac"
  sequences = [
    {
      name                 = "rule1"
      sequence_ip_type     = "ipv4"
      sequence_id          = "1"
      action               = "drop"
      source_ipv4_prefixes = ["10.1.1.0/24"]
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `feature_profile_id` (String) Feature Profile ID
- `name` (String) The name of the Policy_object
- `sequences` (Attributes List) select definition of rule (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sequences))

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the Policy_object

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the Policy_object
- `version` (Number) The version of the Policy_object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Expected import identifier with the format: "policy_object_security_rule_set_id,feature_profile_id"
terraform import sdwan_policy_object_security_rule_set.example "f6b2c44c-693c-4763-b010-895aa3d236bd,f6dd22c8-0b4f-496c-9a0b-6813d1f8b8ac"
```
